stages.title: Catalog
stages.headline: Start with your product information
stages.body: The retailer supplies catalog and inventory tools for its Claude-powered agent to search products.

stages.title: Compare
stages.headline: Give the comparison context
stages.body: The agent compares products using the information and tools the retailer supplies, including its catalog and store policies.

stages.title: Cart
stages.headline: Connect your own commerce tools
stages.body: Cart and checkout tools belong to the merchant-built experience. ecentic has no dedicated Claude checkout connection today.
